prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square detailed painterly naturalistic editorial image for the Swedish Knights of Ålleberg legend. Show ONE representative GHOST KNIGHT SLEEPING upright on a stone bench inside a vast quiet hall within the mountain Ålleberg. He wears complete historically grounded late-fourteenth-century armor with mail and early plate, a plain open-faced helmet reveals closed eyes and peaceful sleeping human face. Both gauntleted hands rest quietly on his lap. His whole armored human figure visible, two arms and two legs. A restrained faint spectral translucence and pale silver rim light identify a dormant ghost, not a fleshless skeleton. Mountain rock and a distant arch recede into mist; solemn cool light and quiet atmosphere communicate an ancient protector waiting to defend the country. No battle, no victims, no blood, no angry corpse face, horns, wings or fantasy glowing sword. Illustrate one knight as a representative, no need depict all twelve or crowds. No text, letters, runes, border or watermark. Contemporary artistic interpretation of the sleeping-armored-knight variant.
visual_requirements: Late medieval armor rather than modern fantasy
depicted_variant: One representative of the sleeping ghostly Knights of Ålleberg, in full late-medieval armor inside the mountain hall.
aura: Solemn dormant ghostly protector, reassuring heroic majesty rather than evil undead.

visual_review.notes: Ordinary human knight in armor with translucent appearance; ghost effect alone does not qualify.
